package_info.why_malicious: The subdomain cdn2.cocoapods.org, previously used by CocoaPods, was abandoned but its DNS records still pointed to GitHub Pages. Attackers hijacked the subdomain to host a casino website, which could have been used for phishing, malware distribution, or other malicious activities under the guise of a trusted brand.

execution_context.file_location: DNS records for cdn2.cocoapods.org pointing to GitHub Pages

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: N/A (malicious content hosted on hijacked subdomain, not a code package)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: When a user visits cdn2.cocoapods.org, the browser loads attacker-controlled web content (e.g., a casino site) from GitHub Pages, leveraging the trust in the CocoaPods domain.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Hosting unrelated or potentially malicious content (e.g., gambling, phishing, malware) on a subdomain of a trusted software supply chain brand.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate subdomains of CocoaPods should only serve official, developer-related content. Instead, the subdomain served unrelated and potentially harmful content.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate use would be serving documentation, CDN assets, or project pages for CocoaPods.
key_indicators: Abandoned subdomain with DNS still pointing to GitHub Pages
No official CocoaPods branding or developer resources

attack_chain.action: Attacker identifies abandoned subdomain (cdn2.cocoapods.org) still pointing to GitHub Pages.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker claims the subdomain via GitHub Pages.

attack_chain.action: Attacker sets up a GitHub Pages repository and configures it to serve content at cdn2.cocoapods.org.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker can now host arbitrary content under the trusted CocoaPods subdomain.

attack_chain.action: Malicious or deceptive content (e.g., casino site) is served to users visiting cdn2.cocoapods.org.
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential phishing, malware distribution, or brand abuse.

behavioral_signatures: Sudden change in content served from a known subdomain
Subdomain serving unrelated or suspicious content (e.g., gambling, phishing, malware)
Subdomain points to GitHub Pages but is not referenced in official project repositories
file_indicators: DNS CNAME records for subdomains pointing to *.github.io
Presence of unrelated HTML/JS content in GitHub Pages repositories linked to trusted domains
network_indicators: Unusual traffic to subdomains of trusted brands serving non-developer content
Requests to cdn2.cocoapods.org returning content unrelated to CocoaPods
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor DNS records for subdomains of trusted brands pointing to third-party hosting (e.g., GitHub Pages). Regularly scan subdomains for unexpected content changes. Alert on subdomains serving unrelated or suspicious content, especially if the subdomain is not referenced in official documentation or repositories.
